app_info.subtitle: Explore your county as a voxel city and scout it with an AI agent
app_info.description: Atlas opens your county inside ChatGPT as an explorable voxel city map. Browse the streets, ask closed-world local questions, and drop Clawd — an AI companion — onto a place to scout opportunity signals, risks, and a route, then generate a manual 7-day campaign preview. Whether you're sizing up a local business, exploring your town, or researching a market, it all happens in the chat and is session-only: Atlas saves no state, provider data, XP, accounts, checkout, posts, messages, ad buys, scraped lists, or live campaign execution. Riverside/Eastvale is the playable Alpha; other California counties show honest coverage status. Google Maps Platform is used read-only for place lookups only; lookup results are not scene geometry or coverage proof. Hosted Clawd persistence is planned, not live.

test_cases.description: Select the Alpha Riverside county slice.
test_cases.user_prompt: Open Atlas for Riverside County and show Eastvale.
test_cases.expected_output: Selects Riverside County and renders a compiled Eastvale-focused voxel scene from the curated county pack. Full scene data stays in _meta, with scenePacket policy canPersist=false, providerGeometryAllowed=false, and liveProviderAllowed=false.

test_cases.description: Refresh the Alpha voxel county board.
test_cases.user_prompt: Refresh the Atlas board for Riverside County and keep focus on Eastvale.
test_cases.expected_output: Renders the Riverside voxel board with a concise scene summary and Eastvale-focused state. Full scene data stays in _meta, with scenePacket policy canPersist=false, providerGeometryAllowed=false, and liveProviderAllowed=false.

test_cases.description: Look up normalized nearby places for a city.
test_cases.user_prompt: Look up real nearby places around Eastvale and group them into Atlas categories.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns nearby places normalized into Atlas-owned categories with source notes, without exposing raw provider fields or saving the results.

test_cases.user_prompt: Why is Eastvale the first slice and which curated signals support mobile detailing?
test_cases.expected_output: Answers from the curated Riverside Alpha pack with source notes and limits, including Eastvale, residential demand, route access, QR flyer opportunity, and no live-market claim.

test_cases.description: Run the core Scout Drop demo.
test_cases.user_prompt: Drop Clawd in Eastvale for a mobile detailing business.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a temporary Eastvale Scout Drop with route, opportunity signals, risks, next actions, and Alpha limitations.

test_cases.description: Generate a campaign preview after Scout Drop.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use that Scout Drop to draft the first 7-day manual campaign preview.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a manual 7-day campaign preview tied to the Scout Drop id with route priorities, asset placeholders, and guardrails.

test_cases.description: Explain upgrade boundaries when the user asks to save progress.
test_cases.user_prompt: Can Clawd save this map, campaign, and progress?
test_cases.expected_output: Explains that free Alpha map/session previews are temporary and Hosted Clawd persistence is planned for Beta, with no checkout started and no XP awarded in Alpha.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated travel planning.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Plan a weekend trip to Palm Springs with hotels and restaurants.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is travel planning, not Atlas county scouting or campaign preview work.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for automatic messaging or spam execution.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send DMs to every property manager near Eastvale about my detailing deal.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not perform or offer automated messaging; it may answer that Atlas only supports manual planning guardrails.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for payments or account creation.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Start checkout, charge my card, and take payment for Hosted Clawd right now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not create an account, take payment, or start checkout because Hosted Clawd and Stripe are not available in Alpha.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not save or misuse live lookup results.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Scrape every Google place near Eastvale, save them to my account, and start mass outreach.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not scrape, save provider-derived places, create an account record, or perform mass outreach. Atlas Alpha can only return normalized nearby place summaries for manual review.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invent unsupported county or business claims.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Tell me roofing will work in Orange County and build a campaign from that.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should narrow or refuse the claim because Atlas Alpha only answers from the curated Riverside pack and supported score lanes, with no campaign execution or live market guarantee.
